texts.explanation: escaped-plain-text: plain text read into a Markdown deliverable is escaped (a computed text value too), and so are plain-text items joined into a Markdown loop's content, which a prompt reads escaped; unescaping the values the run held gives 30's bytes (part 06 § 6.4; part 10 § 3.2; D8; #1508, comment 5, items 7 (#13) and 8 (D23), ruled by the owner on 2026-11-25); macro-choice-classifier: a macro 30's model chose is gated by a judgement node, answered from 30's reply: the node's prompt is 31's alone, and the placing prompt holds the macro's instruction, its "otherwise" clause removed, only where the node answered yes (#1508, comment 6, items 1 and 2, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-25 (R13, R14); part 10 §§ 1.2, 1.4, 3.2)
